evidence.title: UI Rules: Brand Guidelines for AI Tools
Pricing: Starter, Pro, and Team plans – UI Rules

name: UI Rules
summary: Workspace that stores your brand's design rules and tokens and serves them to AI coding tools over MCP.
description: UI Rules is a workspace for brand and design-system guidelines: author rules with Do/Don't/Caution/Info markers, manage style tokens (color, typography, radius, shadow, spacing, sizing) and connect AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, v0, Lovable, Codex and Figma Make over MCP so generated UI follows your brand. Brand styles can be imported from Figma variables, CSS themes or shadcn presets.
contains: free Starter plan; Pro $24/mo with 14-day trial; Team $79/mo
connects Cursor, Claude Code, v0, Lovable, Codex and Figma Make over MCP
styles: colors, typography, radius, shadows, sizing, spacing
rules with Do, Don't, Caution or Info guidance and Required/Recommended/Optional importance
import tokens from Figma variables, CSS theme or shadcn preset
Pro bundle: 224 React blocks and 53 React components with guidelines attached
